Process: (1) Federal taxable income apportioned to NC by table 7500, (2) Add NC-specific additions by table 51220, (3) Subtract NC-specific subtractions by table 51220, (4) Calculate NC state taxable income, (5) Apply NC 2.5% flat tax rate (LOWEST STATE RATE IN THE NATION), (6) Subtract NC state credits (Jobs creation, Film production, Renewable energy, Historic preservation, etc.), (7) Calculate refund or amount owed. NC uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor). NC tax rate history: 2025+ is 2.5% (lowest in nation), 2019-2024 varied from 2.5% to 6.9%, Before 2019 had progressive rates up to 6.9%. NC credits: Article 3J (Jobs creation), Article 3F (Film/entertainment production), Article 3B (Renewable energy), Article 3H (Historic rehabilitation). Reference: NC Form CD-405 (Corporation Income Tax Return), NC General Statute § 105-130.3 (Tax rate of 2.5%), NC General Statute § 105-130.4 (Single-sales apportionment), NC Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Bulletin 2025.

policy_statement.policy_description: OR corporate excise tax (FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR state corporate excise tax calculation (FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS): 1. Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28]; 2. Apportioned to OR × [Single-sales apportionment %]; 3. OR additions + [Federal interest, 199A addback, etc.]; 4. OR subtractions - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, etc.]; 5. OR taxable income = [Result]; 6. OR tax rate × 7.6% (FINANCIAL INSTITUTION RATE); 7. OR excise tax = [Tax before minimum]; 8. OR minimum tax = [Based on Oregon sales - see ORS 317.090]; 9. OR tax before credits = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax); 10. OR credits - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion credits]; 11. OR tax liability = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits). Note: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.061(2) (Financial institution tax rate - 7.6%), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule), ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment)."

policy_statement.policy_description: OR corporate excise tax (REGULAR CORPORATIONS)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "OR state corporate excise tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28]; 2. Apportioned to OR × [Single-sales apportionment %]; 3. OR additions + [Federal interest, 199A addback, state tax refunds, etc.]; 4. OR subtractions - [OR municipal interest, OR NOL, qualified dividends, etc.]; 5. OR taxable income = [Result]; 6. OR tax rate × 6.6% (flat rate for regular corporations); 7. OR excise tax = [Tax before minimum]; 8. OR minimum tax = [Based on Oregon sales - see schedule below]; 9. OR tax before credits = MAX(excise tax, minimum tax); 10. OR credits - [Film, renewable energy, business expansion, etc.]; 11. OR tax liability = MAX(minimum tax, tax - credits). CRITICAL: Credits cannot reduce tax below the minimum tax amount. Oregon Minimum Tax Schedule (ORS 317.090): Less than $500,000 in OR sales: $150; $500,000 to $999,999: $500; $1 million to $1.999 million: $1,000; $2 million to $2.999 million: $1,500; $3 million to $4.999 million: $2,000; $5 million to $6.999 million: $4,000; $7 million to $9.999 million: $7,500; $10 million to $24.999 million: $15,000; $25 million to $49.999 million: $30,000; $50 million to $74.999 million: $50,000; $75 million to $99.999 million: $75,000; $100 million or more: $100,000. Oregon provides various tax credits including: Film and video production credit; Renewable energy development credit; Business expansion credit; Housing development credit. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.061(1) (Tax rate - 6.6%), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax schedule), ORS 317.267 (Single-sales factor apportionment), Oregon Department of Revenue Corporate Tax Credits Guide."

policy_statement.policy_description: No OR nexus - no tax liability
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No OR nexus - no tax liability. Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in OR. Any estimated payments are refunded. Reference: ORS 317.010 (Nexus requirements)."

policy_statement.policy_description: No OR taxable income - but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No OR taxable income - but MINIMUM TAX STILL APPLIES. Corporation has OR nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. However, Oregon MINIMUM TAX is still required based on Oregon sales. CRITICAL: Even with no taxable income or a loss, corporations with Oregon nexus must pay the minimum tax. The minimum tax ranges from $150 to $100,000 based on Oregon sales. Oregon net operating loss (NOL) rules: Oregon allows NOL carryforward; Carryback rules vary by tax year; NOL does not eliminate minimum tax requirement. Reference: Oregon Form 20 Instructions (Corporation Excise Tax Return), ORS 317.090 (Minimum tax - applies regardless of income), ORS 317.476 (Net operating loss deduction)."

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates final Washington Business and Occupation (B&O) tax liability. IMPORTANT: Washington has NO corporate income tax.
